about: Tasks for professional/industrial sites (Wirestock Exhibit A domains), English and Chinese. 2-3 takes per site, then move to the next site. Apply with: node infra/registry-api/import-tasks.mjs infra/registry-api/imports/2026-11-03-professional-site-tasks.json --user <you> --apply

tasks.name: Professional kitchen: dicing onions at the prep station
tasks.headline: Peel and dice onions with a chef's knife at a stainless-steel prep station
tasks.description: Peel and dice onions with a chef's knife at a stainless-steel prep station. Where: a culinary school or restaurant kitchen with stainless-steel worktops and professional equipment in view. You need: 3–4 onions, a chef's knife, a cutting board, a stainless-steel container (hotel pan) for the diced onion, a bin for peels.
steps: Show the prep station, the onions and the knife, and say what you are going to make.
Cut the ends off an onion and peel it.
Halve it and make horizontal and vertical cuts.
Dice it across and slide the dice into the container with the knife blade.
Repeat with the other onions, describing each step as you finish it.
Show the full container, wipe the board, then stop recording.
pitfalls: The kitchen must look professional: stainless steel and real equipment in frame, not a home kitchen.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 专业厨房：在备餐台切洋葱丁
zh.headline: 在不锈钢备餐台上用厨刀给洋葱去皮并切丁
zh.description: 在不锈钢备餐台上用厨刀给洋葱去皮并切丁。场所：烹饪学校或餐厅后厨，不锈钢台面，画面里能看到专业厨房设备。所需物品：3–4 个洋葱、厨刀、砧板、一个装洋葱丁的不锈钢方盘、一个放洋葱皮的垃圾桶。
steps: 展示备餐台、洋葱和厨刀，说出你要做什么。
切掉洋葱两头并剥皮。
对半切开，先横切再竖切。
横向切成丁，用刀面把洋葱丁推进不锈钢方盘。
继续切其余的洋葱，每完成一步就说出来。
展示装满的方盘，擦干净砧板，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 厨房必须看起来专业：画面里有不锈钢台面和专业设备，不能是家庭厨房。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Professional kitchen: prepping vegetables into hotel pans
tasks.headline: Wash, peel, slice and portion vegetables into stainless-steel pans for service
tasks.description: Wash, peel, slice and portion vegetables into stainless-steel pans for service. Where: a culinary school or restaurant kitchen with stainless-steel worktops and professional equipment in view. You need: carrots, cucumbers and peppers, a peeler, a chef's knife, a cutting board, 2–3 stainless-steel pans, cling film or lids.
steps: Show the vegetables, tools and pans and say what you will prepare.
Wash the vegetables at the prep sink.
Peel the carrots and slice them into even sticks.
Slice the cucumber and cut the pepper into strips.
Put each vegetable into its own pan and cover it.
Show the finished pans on the shelf or trolley, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Use real kitchen equipment (prep sink, steel pans, trolley or walk-in) so the site is clearly professional.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 专业厨房：备菜装入不锈钢方盘
zh.headline: 把蔬菜洗净、去皮、切好，分装进不锈钢方盘备用
zh.description: 把蔬菜洗净、去皮、切好，分装进不锈钢方盘备用。场所：烹饪学校或餐厅后厨，不锈钢台面，画面里能看到专业厨房设备。所需物品：胡萝卜、黄瓜、彩椒、削皮刀、厨刀、砧板、2–3 个不锈钢方盘、保鲜膜或盖子。
steps: 展示蔬菜、工具和方盘，说出你要准备什么。
在备菜水池把蔬菜洗干净。
胡萝卜去皮，切成均匀的条。
黄瓜切片，彩椒切条。
每种蔬菜分别放进一个方盘并盖好。
把备好的方盘放到架子或推车上展示，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 使用真实的厨房设备（备菜水池、不锈钢方盘、推车或冷库），让场所一看就是专业厨房。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Greenhouse: weeding a crop bed with a hand hoe
tasks.headline: Remove weeds between crop rows inside a greenhouse with a hand hoe and collect them
tasks.description: Remove weeds between crop rows inside a greenhouse with a hand hoe and collect them. Where: inside a commercial greenhouse, between rows of a clearly visible crop (for example lettuce, tomatoes or strawberries). Not outdoors, not a lawn. You need: a hand hoe or weeding trowel, gardening gloves, a bucket or basket for the weeds.
steps: Show the greenhouse, the crop rows and your tools, and say which crop you are weeding.
Kneel or crouch at the start of a row.
Loosen the weeds around the plants with the hoe without touching the crop.
Pull the loosened weeds out by the root and drop them in the bucket.
Move along the row and repeat, saying what you just cleared.
Show the cleared row and the full bucket, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Use a proper weeding tool, not a stick, and keep the crop clearly visible in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 温室：用小锄头给作物畦除草
zh.headline: 在温室里用小锄头清除作物行间的杂草并收集起来
zh.description: 在温室里用小锄头清除作物行间的杂草并收集起来。场所：商业温室内部，在能清楚看出是什么作物的行间（例如生菜、番茄或草莓）。不要在室外，也不要在草坪上。所需物品：小锄头或除草铲、园艺手套、装杂草的桶或筐。
steps: 展示温室、作物行和工具，说出你在给什么作物除草。
在一行的起点蹲下或跪下。
用锄头把作物周围的杂草松开，不要碰到作物。
把松动的杂草连根拔出，放进桶里。
沿着这一行往前走，重复操作，说出刚清理了哪里。
展示清理干净的一行和装满杂草的桶，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 要用正规的除草工具，不能用木棍；作物要一直清楚地出现在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Greenhouse: transplanting seedlings into pots
tasks.headline: Move seedlings from a seed tray into individual pots at a greenhouse potting bench
tasks.description: Move seedlings from a seed tray into individual pots at a greenhouse potting bench. Where: a potting bench inside a commercial greenhouse, with crops or seedling racks visible behind. You need: a seed tray of seedlings, 10–12 small pots, potting soil, a trowel or dibber, a watering can, labels.
steps: Show the bench, the seedlings and the pots, and say what you are transplanting.
Fill the pots with soil using the trowel.
Make a hole in each pot with the dibber.
Ease one seedling out of the tray by its leaves and set it in a pot.
Firm the soil around it, and repeat for the other pots.
Water the pots, add a label, show the tray of pots, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Hold seedlings by the leaves, not the stem, and keep both hands over the bench.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 温室：把幼苗移栽到花盆里
zh.headline: 在温室的育苗台上把育苗盘里的幼苗移栽到单独的花盆中
zh.description: 在温室的育苗台上把育苗盘里的幼苗移栽到单独的花盆中。场所：商业温室内的育苗操作台，背景能看到作物或育苗架。所需物品：一盘育苗、10–12 个小花盆、营养土、小铲子或打孔器、喷壶、标签。
steps: 展示操作台、幼苗和花盆，说出你要移栽什么。
用小铲子把花盆装满土。
用打孔器在每个盆里戳一个洞。
捏住叶子把一棵幼苗从育苗盘里取出，放进花盆。
把周围的土压实，其余花盆重复操作。
给花盆浇水、插上标签，展示整盘花盆，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 捏叶子，不要捏茎；双手保持在操作台上方。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Furniture workshop: assembling a cabinet with a drill driver
tasks.headline: Assemble a cabinet carcass from panels on a workbench with a cordless drill driver
tasks.description: Assemble a cabinet carcass from panels on a workbench with a cordless drill driver. Where: a furniture factory, woodshop or assembly workshop: workbench, power tools and machinery or stacked panels visible. Not a home. You need: the panels and fittings of a small cabinet, a cordless drill driver with the right bit, screws or cam fittings, clamps, a square.
steps: Show the workshop, the panels and the drill, and say what you are assembling.
Lay out the panels and fittings on the bench.
Clamp the side panel to the base and check it with the square.
Drive the screws with the drill driver.
Fit the other side and the top the same way, describing each joint as you finish it.
Stand the carcass up, show it is square, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Wear safety glasses; keep the drill and both hands on the bench in front of you.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 家具车间：用电钻组装柜体
zh.headline: 在工作台上用充电式电钻把板件组装成柜体
zh.description: 在工作台上用充电式电钻把板件组装成柜体。场所：家具厂、木工房或装配车间：画面里有工作台、电动工具、机器或成摞的板材。不能是家里。所需物品：小柜子的板件和五金件、装好合适批头的充电电钻、螺丝或偏心件、夹具、直角尺。
steps: 展示车间、板件和电钻，说出你要组装什么。
把板件和五金件摆在工作台上。
把侧板夹到底板上，用直角尺检查。
用电钻拧紧螺丝。
用同样的方法装另一侧板和顶板，每装好一个连接就说出来。
把柜体立起来，展示它是方正的，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 戴护目镜；电钻和双手保持在面前的工作台上。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Furniture workshop: fitting hinges and a handle to a door
tasks.headline: Mark, drill and fit hinges and a handle to a cabinet door on the workbench
tasks.description: Mark, drill and fit hinges and a handle to a cabinet door on the workbench. Where: a furniture factory, woodshop or assembly workshop with workbench and power tools visible. You need: a cabinet door panel, 2 hinges, a handle with screws, a tape measure, a pencil, a drill driver with drill and screw bits.
steps: Show the door, the hinges, the handle and the tools, and say what you will fit.
Measure and mark the hinge and handle positions with the pencil.
Drill the pilot holes at the marks.
Screw the hinges onto the door.
Fit the handle and tighten its screws.
Open and close the hinges to show they move, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Clamp the door or hold it flat on the bench before drilling.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 家具车间：给柜门装合页和拉手
zh.headline: 在工作台上为柜门划线、打孔并装上合页和拉手
zh.description: 在工作台上为柜门划线、打孔并装上合页和拉手。场所：家具厂、木工房或装配车间，画面里能看到工作台和电动工具。所需物品：一块柜门板、2 个合页、带螺丝的拉手、卷尺、铅笔、配钻头和批头的电钻。
steps: 展示柜门、合页、拉手和工具，说出你要装什么。
用卷尺量好位置，用铅笔标出合页和拉手的位置。
在标记处打引孔。
把合页拧到门上。
装上拉手并拧紧螺丝。
开合几次合页展示它能活动，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 打孔前先把门板夹住或平放在工作台上按稳。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Supermarket: restocking and facing a shelf
tasks.headline: Restock a supermarket shelf from a crate and face the products to the front
tasks.description: Restock a supermarket shelf from a crate and face the products to the front. Where: a supermarket aisle or stock room during quiet hours, with shelving and product displays visible. You need: a crate or roll cage of products, a box cutter, the shelf to fill.
steps: Show the aisle, the shelf gap and the crate, and say which product you are restocking.
Open the outer carton with the box cutter.
Move the older stock to the front of the shelf.
Place the new items behind it, labels facing out.
Pull every item to the shelf edge so the row is neat (facing).
Flatten the empty carton, show the full shelf, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Film when the aisle is quiet and keep shoppers' faces out of frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 超市：补货和理货
zh.headline: 从货筐给超市货架补货，并把商品理到最前面摆整齐
zh.description: 从货筐给超市货架补货，并把商品理到最前面摆整齐。场所：超市货架通道或仓库，客流少的时段，画面里能看到货架和商品陈列。所需物品：一筐或一笼货、开箱刀、需要补货的货架。
steps: 展示通道、货架空位和货筐，说出你要补什么商品。
用开箱刀打开外箱。
把旧货移到货架最前面。
把新货放在后面，标签朝外。
把每件商品拉到货架边缘，排整齐。
把空纸箱压平，展示补满的货架，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 在客流少的时候拍摄，不要拍到顾客的脸。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Supermarket: checking dates and rotating stock
tasks.headline: Check best-before dates on a chilled shelf, remove expired items and rotate the stock
tasks.description: Check best-before dates on a chilled shelf, remove expired items and rotate the stock. Where: a supermarket chilled or dairy aisle, or its stock room. You need: the shelf section to check, a basket for removed items, a price-label gun or marker if used in the store.
steps: Show the chilled shelf and say what you will check.
Pick up each item and read its date aloud.
Put expired or damaged items in the basket.
Move the shortest-dated items to the front.
Fill gaps from the back stock and face the row.
Show the basket and the tidy shelf, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Say the dates and decisions out loud as you go; keep shoppers out of frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 超市：检查保质期并轮换货品
zh.headline: 检查冷柜货架上的保质期，下架过期商品并按日期轮换
zh.description: 检查冷柜货架上的保质期，下架过期商品并按日期轮换。场所：超市冷柜或乳制品区，或其仓库。所需物品：要检查的货架区、装下架商品的筐、店里使用的标价枪或记号笔。
steps: 展示冷柜货架，说出你要检查什么。
拿起每件商品，把日期念出来。
把过期或破损的商品放进筐里。
把日期最近的商品移到最前面。
从后面的库存补齐空位并理整齐。
展示下架筐和整理好的货架，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 边做边把日期和判断说出来；不要拍到顾客。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Courier station: sorting parcels onto shelves by code
tasks.headline: Sort incoming parcels by pickup code onto the station's numbered shelves
tasks.description: Sort incoming parcels by pickup code onto the station's numbered shelves. Where: a working courier/express station or parcel warehouse with numbered shelving. You need: a cart or pile of incoming parcels, the shelving, a handheld scanner or code labels if the station uses them.
steps: Show the station, the shelves and the parcel pile, and say what you will sort.
Pick up a parcel and read its shelf code aloud.
Scan it if the station uses a scanner.
Place it on the matching shelf, label facing out.
Repeat for the pile, saying each code and shelf.
Show the empty cart and the filled shelves, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Turn labels away from the camera or keep them out of focus where names and phone numbers show.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 快递驿站：按取件码分拣上架
zh.headline: 按取件码把到件包裹分拣放到驿站的编号货架上
zh.description: 按取件码把到件包裹分拣放到驿站的编号货架上。场所：正在营业的快递驿站或包裹仓库，有编号货架。所需物品：一车或一堆到件包裹、货架、驿站使用的扫码枪或编码标签。
steps: 展示驿站、货架和包裹堆，说出你要分拣什么。
拿起一个包裹，把货架码念出来。
如果驿站用扫码枪，就扫一下。
放到对应的货架上，面单朝外。
把整堆包裹都这样处理，每件都说出编码和货架。
展示空车和放满的货架，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 有姓名和电话的面单不要正对镜头，或保持在焦点外。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Warehouse: picking and packing an order into a carton
tasks.headline: Pick the items of an order from warehouse shelves and pack and tape them in a carton
tasks.description: Pick the items of an order from warehouse shelves and pack and tape them in a carton. Where: a warehouse, e-commerce fulfilment area or packaging station with racks and a packing table. You need: a printed order or picking list, 3–5 items on the racks, a carton, void fill, a tape gun.
steps: Show the packing station and the order, and read out the items.
Walk to the racks and pick each item, saying what you took.
Fold the carton into shape and tape the bottom.
Place the items in the carton with void fill.
Close and tape the carton with the tape gun.
Show the sealed carton with its label, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Keep both hands and the carton in frame at the packing table.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 仓库：拣货并装箱打包
zh.headline: 按订单从仓库货架上拣货，装进纸箱并封箱
zh.description: 按订单从仓库货架上拣货，装进纸箱并封箱。场所：仓库、电商发货区或包装台，有货架和打包台。所需物品：打印好的订单或拣货单、货架上的 3–5 件商品、纸箱、缓冲填充物、胶带枪。
steps: 展示打包台和订单，把要拣的商品念出来。
走到货架前逐件拣货，说出拿了什么。
把纸箱折好，封好箱底。
把商品放进箱子，加缓冲填充物。
合上箱子，用胶带枪封箱。
展示封好并贴好面单的箱子，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 在打包台操作时双手和纸箱都要在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Electronics workshop: assembling a board into its enclosure
tasks.headline: Fit a circuit board into its enclosure, connect it and close the case with screws
tasks.description: Fit a circuit board into its enclosure, connect it and close the case with screws. Where: an electronics factory line or assembly workshop with an ESD bench, tools and parts bins. You need: a circuit board, its plastic or metal enclosure, cables, small screws, a precision screwdriver or electric screwdriver, an ESD wrist strap.
steps: Show the bench, the board and the enclosure, and say what you will assemble.
Put on the wrist strap and lay out the parts.
Seat the board on its standoffs in the enclosure.
Plug in the cables and route them.
Fit the lid and drive the screws.
Show the finished unit, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Work under good bench light so small parts are sharp; keep the parts tray in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 电子车间：把电路板装进外壳
zh.headline: 把电路板装进外壳、接好线并用螺丝合上外壳
zh.description: 把电路板装进外壳、接好线并用螺丝合上外壳。场所：电子工厂产线或装配车间，有防静电工作台、工具和零件盒。所需物品：电路板、配套的塑料或金属外壳、线缆、小螺丝、精密螺丝刀或电动螺丝刀、防静电手环。
steps: 展示工作台、电路板和外壳，说出你要组装什么。
戴上防静电手环，把零件摆好。
把电路板放到外壳里的支柱上。
插好线缆并理好走线。
盖上外壳，拧紧螺丝。
展示装好的成品，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 在明亮的台灯下操作，让小零件看得清楚；零件盒要在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Electronics workshop: soldering wires to a terminal board
tasks.headline: Strip, tin and solder wires to a terminal board at a soldering station
tasks.description: Strip, tin and solder wires to a terminal board at a soldering station. Where: an electronics workshop or factory bench with a soldering station and fume extraction. You need: a terminal or prototype board, 4–6 wires, wire strippers, a soldering iron, solder, a helping-hands clamp, side cutters.
steps: Show the station, the board and the wires, and say what you will solder.
Strip the end of each wire.
Tin the wire ends with solder.
Clamp the board and solder each wire to its pad.
Trim the excess wire with the side cutters.
Tug each wire gently to test it, show the board, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Keep the iron tip and the joint in frame; use the extractor and safety glasses.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 电子车间：把导线焊到端子板上
zh.headline: 在焊台上剥线、上锡并把导线焊到端子板上
zh.description: 在焊台上剥线、上锡并把导线焊到端子板上。场所：电子车间或工厂工位，有焊台和排烟设备。所需物品：端子板或洞洞板、4–6 根导线、剥线钳、电烙铁、焊锡、辅助夹具、斜口钳。
steps: 展示焊台、电路板和导线，说出你要焊什么。
把每根导线的线头剥开。
给线头上锡。
夹好板子，把每根线焊到对应的焊盘上。
用斜口钳剪掉多余的线头。
轻拉每根线检查是否焊牢，展示板子，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 烙铁头和焊点要在画面里；打开排烟设备并戴护目镜。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Auto repair shop: removing and refitting a wheel
tasks.headline: Loosen, remove, inspect and refit a car wheel in a repair shop
tasks.description: Loosen, remove, inspect and refit a car wheel in a repair shop. Where: a working auto repair shop with a lift or jack, tool trolley and other cars or equipment visible. You need: a car on a lift or jack stands, a lug wrench or impact wrench, a torque wrench.
steps: Show the shop, the car and the tools, and say which wheel you will work on.
Loosen the wheel nuts.
Raise the car if needed and remove the nuts and the wheel.
Inspect the tyre and brake and say what you see.
Refit the wheel and run the nuts on by hand.
Torque the nuts in a star pattern, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Never work under a car held only by a jack; keep the wheel and both hands in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 汽修店：拆装车轮
zh.headline: 在汽修店里松开、拆下、检查并装回一个车轮
zh.description: 在汽修店里松开、拆下、检查并装回一个车轮。场所：正在营业的汽修店，有举升机或千斤顶、工具车，画面里能看到其他车辆或设备。所需物品：停在举升机或支架上的汽车、轮胎扳手或气动扳手、扭力扳手。
steps: 展示修车间、车辆和工具，说出你要处理哪个车轮。
拧松车轮螺母。
需要的话把车升起，拆下螺母和车轮。
检查轮胎和刹车，说出你看到的情况。
装回车轮，先用手拧上螺母。
按对角顺序用扭力扳手拧紧，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 不要在只靠千斤顶撑着的车下作业；车轮和双手要在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Auto repair shop: replacing the engine air filter
tasks.headline: Open the air box, swap the engine air filter and close it in a repair shop
tasks.description: Open the air box, swap the engine air filter and close it in a repair shop. Where: a working auto repair shop, bonnet open, tools and shop equipment visible. You need: a car with the bonnet open, a new air filter, a screwdriver or socket set, a rag.
steps: Show the shop, the engine bay and the new filter, and say what you will replace.
Undo the clips or screws of the air box.
Lift out the old filter and show how dirty it is.
Wipe out the air box with the rag.
Fit the new filter the right way round and close the box.
Show the closed air box, then stop recording.
pitfalls: This must be done in a real workshop, not mimed on a parked car.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 汽修店：更换空气滤芯
zh.headline: 在汽修店里打开空滤盒，换上新的空气滤芯并装好
zh.description: 在汽修店里打开空滤盒，换上新的空气滤芯并装好。场所：正在营业的汽修店，引擎盖打开，画面里能看到工具和店内设备。所需物品：打开引擎盖的汽车、新的空气滤芯、螺丝刀或套筒、抹布。
steps: 展示修车间、发动机舱和新滤芯，说出你要更换什么。
松开空滤盒的卡扣或螺丝。
取出旧滤芯，展示它有多脏。
用抹布把空滤盒擦干净。
按正确方向装上新滤芯并合上空滤盒。
展示合好的空滤盒，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 必须在真实的汽修店里完成，不能在停着的车上做样子。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: E-bike repair shop: fixing a flat tyre
tasks.headline: Remove the wheel of an e-bike, patch or replace the inner tube and refit it
tasks.description: Remove the wheel of an e-bike, patch or replace the inner tube and refit it. Where: an e-bike or bicycle repair shop with a work stand, tools and bikes visible. You need: an e-bike with a flat tyre, tyre levers, a new inner tube or patch kit, a pump, spanners.
steps: Show the shop, the bike and the tools, and say what you will repair.
Remove the wheel from the frame.
Lever one side of the tyre off and pull out the inner tube.
Find the puncture, then patch it or take a new tube.
Fit the tube, seat the tyre and inflate it.
Refit the wheel, spin it to check, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Keep the wheel on the stand or bench in front of you so both hands stay in view.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 电动车维修店：补胎
zh.headline: 拆下电动车车轮，补内胎或换新内胎后装回
zh.description: 拆下电动车车轮，补内胎或换新内胎后装回。场所：电动车或自行车维修店，画面里有维修架、工具和车辆。所需物品：一辆轮胎没气的电动车、撬胎棒、新内胎或补胎工具、打气筒、扳手。
steps: 展示维修店、车辆和工具，说出你要修什么。
把车轮从车架上拆下来。
用撬胎棒撬下一边外胎，取出内胎。
找到扎破的地方，补好或换新内胎。
装回内胎和外胎，打气。
装回车轮，转一转检查，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 把车轮放在面前的维修架或台面上，让双手一直在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Appliance repair: servicing an electric fan
tasks.headline: Unplug, open, clean and reassemble an electric fan at a repair bench
tasks.description: Unplug, open, clean and reassemble an electric fan at a repair bench. Where: an appliance repair shop or workshop bench with tools and appliances visible. You need: an electric fan, a screwdriver, a brush or cloth, a small parts tray.
steps: Show the bench and the fan, unplug it, and say what you will service.
Remove the front grille and the blade nut.
Take off the blade and the rear grille, putting the parts in the tray.
Clean the blade, grilles and motor housing.
Reassemble the rear grille, the blade and the front grille.
Plug it in, show it running, then stop recording.
pitfalls: The fan must be unplugged while it is open; keep the parts tray in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 家电维修：保养电风扇
zh.headline: 在维修台上断电、拆开、清洁并重新组装一台电风扇
zh.description: 在维修台上断电、拆开、清洁并重新组装一台电风扇。场所：家电维修店或维修工作台，画面里有工具和家电。所需物品：一台电风扇、螺丝刀、刷子或抹布、小零件盘。
steps: 展示维修台和风扇，拔掉电源，说出你要保养什么。
拆下前网罩和扇叶螺母。
取下扇叶和后网罩，把零件放进零件盘。
清洁扇叶、网罩和电机外壳。
依次装回后网罩、扇叶和前网罩。
插上电源，展示风扇正常运转，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 拆开时风扇必须断电；零件盘要在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Garment workshop: machine-sewing a seam
tasks.headline: Pin two fabric pieces and sew them together on an industrial sewing machine
tasks.description: Pin two fabric pieces and sew them together on an industrial sewing machine. Where: a garment factory or tailoring workshop with industrial sewing machines and fabric visible. You need: two cut fabric pieces, pins, an industrial sewing machine, thread, scissors.
steps: Show the workshop, the machine and the fabric, and say what you will sew.
Line up the two pieces and pin them along the edge.
Place the fabric under the presser foot and lower it.
Sew the seam, guiding the fabric and removing pins as you go.
Backstitch at the end and cut the threads.
Open the seam and show it, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Keep fingers clear of the needle; keep both hands and the needle area in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 服装车间：用缝纫机车缝合
zh.headline: 把两块布料用别针固定，在工业缝纫机上车缝在一起
zh.description: 把两块布料用别针固定，在工业缝纫机上车缝在一起。场所：服装厂或裁缝车间，画面里有工业缝纫机和布料。所需物品：两块裁好的布料、别针、工业缝纫机、线、剪刀。
steps: 展示车间、缝纫机和布料，说出你要缝什么。
把两块布对齐，沿边缘用别针固定。
把布放到压脚下，放下压脚。
车缝，一边引导布料一边取下别针。
在末端回针，剪断线头。
打开缝份展示缝好的线迹，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 手指远离机针；双手和机针区域要在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Garment workshop: cutting fabric pieces from a pattern
tasks.headline: Lay a paper pattern on fabric, mark it and cut the pieces with shears
tasks.description: Lay a paper pattern on fabric, mark it and cut the pieces with shears. Where: a garment factory or tailoring workshop with a cutting table. You need: fabric, a paper pattern, tailor's chalk, pattern weights or pins, fabric shears.
steps: Show the cutting table, the fabric and the pattern, and say what you will cut.
Smooth the fabric flat on the table.
Lay the pattern pieces on it and weigh or pin them down.
Trace around the pattern with chalk.
Cut along the lines with the shears.
Stack the cut pieces and show them, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Cut on the table, not in the air, so the shears and both hands stay in view.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 服装车间：按纸样裁布
zh.headline: 把纸样铺在布料上，划好线后用剪刀裁出衣片
zh.description: 把纸样铺在布料上，划好线后用剪刀裁出衣片。场所：服装厂或裁缝车间，有裁剪台。所需物品：布料、纸样、划粉、压铁或别针、裁布剪刀。
steps: 展示裁剪台、布料和纸样，说出你要裁什么。
把布料在台面上抚平。
把纸样铺上去，用压铁或别针固定。
用划粉沿纸样画线。
用剪刀沿线裁剪。
把裁好的衣片叠好展示，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 在台面上剪，不要悬空剪，让剪刀和双手一直在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Lab: weighing a powder and preparing a solution
tasks.headline: Weigh a powder on a lab balance and dissolve it to make a solution
tasks.description: Weigh a powder on a lab balance and dissolve it to make a solution. Where: a teaching or research laboratory with a bench, balance and glassware visible. You need: a lab balance, weighing boat, spatula, the powder (e.g. salt), a beaker, a volumetric flask, distilled water, a stirring rod, gloves and goggles.
steps: Show the bench and materials, and say what solution you will make.
Place the weighing boat on the balance and tare it.
Weigh out the powder with the spatula, reading the mass aloud.
Tip the powder into the beaker and add some water.
Stir until it dissolves, then pour it into the flask and fill to the mark.
Stopper, mix, label the flask and show it, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Wear gloves and goggles; read every number you see aloud.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 实验室：称量粉末并配制溶液
zh.headline: 在天平上称量粉末并溶解配制成溶液
zh.description: 在天平上称量粉末并溶解配制成溶液。场所：教学或科研实验室，画面里有实验台、天平和玻璃器皿。所需物品：天平、称量舟、药匙、粉末试剂（例如食盐）、烧杯、容量瓶、蒸馏水、玻璃棒、手套和护目镜。
steps: 展示实验台和材料，说出你要配制什么溶液。
把称量舟放到天平上并去皮。
用药匙称取粉末，把读数念出来。
把粉末倒进烧杯，加一些水。
搅拌到完全溶解，倒入容量瓶并定容到刻度线。
塞好瓶塞、摇匀、贴标签并展示，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 戴手套和护目镜；看到的每个读数都要念出来。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Lab: pipetting liquid into labelled tubes
tasks.headline: Transfer measured volumes of liquid into a rack of labelled tubes with a micropipette
tasks.description: Transfer measured volumes of liquid into a rack of labelled tubes with a micropipette. Where: a teaching or research laboratory bench. You need: a micropipette, tips, a tip waste box, a rack of labelled tubes, a reagent bottle or beaker of coloured water, gloves.
steps: Show the bench, the pipette and the tubes, and say what volume you will transfer.
Set the volume on the pipette and fit a tip.
Draw up the liquid from the bottle.
Dispense it into the first tube and eject the tip.
Repeat for each tube, saying the tube label as you fill it.
Cap the tubes, show the rack, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Coloured water makes the transfers visible; keep the tube rack in front of you.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 实验室：用移液枪向标记好的试管加样
zh.headline: 用微量移液器把定量液体转移到一排标记好的试管中
zh.description: 用微量移液器把定量液体转移到一排标记好的试管中。场所：教学或科研实验室的实验台。所需物品：微量移液器、枪头、废枪头盒、一架贴好标签的试管、一瓶或一烧杯有颜色的水、手套。
steps: 展示实验台、移液器和试管，说出你要转移多少体积。
在移液器上设好体积，装上枪头。
从瓶中吸取液体。
打进第一支试管并退掉枪头。
每支试管重复操作，加样时说出试管标签。
盖好试管盖，展示试管架，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 用有颜色的水，让每次转移看得清楚；试管架放在面前。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Professional kitchen: preparing and plating a salad
tasks.headline: Cut, dress and plate a salad at the prep station and set it on the pass
tasks.description: Cut, dress and plate a salad at the prep station and set it on the pass. Where: a culinary school or restaurant kitchen with stainless-steel worktops and professional equipment in view. You need: lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, a chef's knife, a cutting board, a mixing bowl, dressing, two plates.
steps: Show the station and the ingredients, and say what you will plate.
Wash and tear the lettuce into the bowl.
Slice the tomatoes and cucumber on the board.
Add them to the bowl, dress and toss the salad.
Arrange the salad neatly on the plates.
Wipe the plate rims, place them on the pass, show them, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Plate on the steel worktop in front of you so both hands and the plate stay in view.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 专业厨房：制作并装盘一份沙拉
zh.headline: 在备餐台切配、调味并装盘一份沙拉，放到出菜口
zh.description: 在备餐台切配、调味并装盘一份沙拉，放到出菜口。场所：烹饪学校或餐厅后厨，不锈钢台面，画面里能看到专业厨房设备。所需物品：生菜、番茄、黄瓜、厨刀、砧板、拌菜盆、沙拉酱、两个盘子。
steps: 展示操作台和食材，说出你要做什么菜。
把生菜洗净，撕成小块放进盆里。
在砧板上把番茄和黄瓜切片。
放进盆里，加酱汁拌匀。
把沙拉整齐地摆在盘子上。
擦干净盘边，放到出菜口展示，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 在面前的不锈钢台面上装盘，让双手和盘子一直在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Greenhouse: harvesting vegetables into crates
tasks.headline: Pick ripe vegetables from the plants inside a greenhouse and pack them in a harvest crate
tasks.description: Pick ripe vegetables from the plants inside a greenhouse and pack them in a harvest crate. Where: inside a commercial greenhouse with a clearly visible crop ready to pick (for example tomatoes, cucumbers or peppers). You need: harvest shears or a knife if needed, a harvest crate, gloves.
steps: Show the greenhouse, the crop and the crate, and say what you will harvest.
Check a plant and say which fruits are ripe.
Cut or twist off the ripe fruits.
Lay them in the crate in neat rows.
Move along the row and repeat, saying how many you picked.
Show the full crate and the picked row, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Pick only what the greenhouse staff agree to; keep the plants and the crate in frame.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 温室：采收蔬菜装箱
zh.headline: 在温室里从植株上采摘成熟的蔬菜，整齐地装进采收箱
zh.description: 在温室里从植株上采摘成熟的蔬菜，整齐地装进采收箱。场所：商业温室内部，有能清楚辨认、可以采摘的作物（例如番茄、黄瓜或彩椒）。所需物品：需要时用采收剪或刀、采收箱、手套。
steps: 展示温室、作物和采收箱，说出你要采收什么。
检查一株植物，说出哪些果实成熟了。
把成熟的果实剪下或拧下来。
在箱子里整齐地排好。
沿着这一行往前走，重复操作，说出采了多少个。
展示装满的采收箱和采过的一行，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 只采温室工作人员同意采的；植株和采收箱要一直在画面里。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。

tasks.name: Furniture workshop: sanding and finishing a wooden part
tasks.headline: Sand a wooden part with an orbital sander, clean it and apply a finish at the workbench
tasks.description: Sand a wooden part with an orbital sander, clean it and apply a finish at the workbench. Where: a furniture factory, woodshop or manufacturing workshop with workbench and power tools visible. You need: a wooden part (shelf, board or chair part), an orbital sander with sandpaper, clamps, a brush or cloth, wood oil or varnish.
steps: Show the workshop, the part and the sander, and say what you will finish.
Clamp the part to the bench.
Sand the surface evenly with the orbital sander.
Switch to finer paper and sand again, then brush off the dust.
Wipe or brush on the oil or varnish.
Show the finished surface, then stop recording.
pitfalls: Wear safety glasses and a dust mask; keep the sander flat and both hands on the bench.
Narrate every 5–10 seconds: do one action, then say what you just did.

zh.name: 家具车间：打磨并给木件上油
zh.headline: 在工作台上用砂光机打磨木件，清理后涂上木蜡油或清漆
zh.description: 在工作台上用砂光机打磨木件，清理后涂上木蜡油或清漆。场所：家具厂、木工房或生产车间，画面里能看到工作台和电动工具。所需物品：一个木件（层板、木板或椅子部件）、装好砂纸的砂光机、夹具、刷子或抹布、木蜡油或清漆。
steps: 展示车间、木件和砂光机，说出你要处理什么。
把木件夹在工作台上。
用砂光机把表面均匀打磨一遍。
换细砂纸再打磨一遍，然后把粉尘刷干净。
擦上或刷上木蜡油或清漆。
展示处理好的表面，然后停止录制。
pitfalls: 戴护目镜和防尘口罩；砂光机保持平放，双手放在工作台上。
每 5–10 秒说一次：做完一个动作，马上说出刚才做了什么。
